claims.statement: Each Haddad bridge instance has its own cache (MYTHOS_BRIDGE_HOME: claims, lock, fence); proven live by #447/#448, each claimed once by its own instance.
review_fn is NOT REQUIRED for V3.2: it is reachable only on the core path (off); the live review gate holds commit work for a human continuation.

Haddad GPU envelope: prompts are capped at 5000 tokens (0 DeviceLost in 626 prompts of 2-4k, 1.8-4.8 percent above 5k); a runtime lost under a turn is awaited and the turn replayed in the same execution.
Tasks too large for Qwen are refused before any GPU time as TASK_TOO_LARGE with a decomposition hint; the local runner gets a compact prompt.
